responsibility: Coordinates evaluation of `NormalizesTo` goals, dispatching normalization by alias kind, integrating projection candidate assembly with the shared goal-kind framework, handling the special solver treatment of normalization goals, and falling back to rigid-alias relation when no non-rigid normalization step applies.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the next solver’s specialization for `NormalizesTo` goals: it dispatches by alias kind, implements `assembly::GoalKind` for normalization, and applies the special fallback from failed non-rigid normalization to rigid alias relation. Unlike the other `solve/*/mod.rs` files, its scope is specifically associated-type/alias normalization rather than general solving infrastructure.
